scope: Exact incoming delta only, separate detached sparse before/after trees and revision-specific targets. Existing 262 findings remain separately recorded and are not classified as introduced by e4.

findings.title: Underlay mode discards disabled, hover, pressed and focus style inputs
findings.evidence: draw_row computes full derived flags and danger variant, then keep_underlay returns through draw_underlay_row without passing those flags. The new painter considers only active index and danger. Exact public consumer default_keeps_disabled_style passes; underlay_keeps_disabled_style fails because disabled and enabled row buffers are identical. Hover/pressed/focus loss is a source finding from the same omission, not an independent interaction test.
findings.repair: Use the canonical row renderer and state resolver for every mode. Configure underlay fill independently of semantic state; supply documented generic variants for baseline state appearance instead of a second baseline-specific row implementation.

findings.title: Underlay mode bypasses public theme/part overrides and content slots
findings.evidence: Border is forced to RGB(58,58,58), danger text RGB(232,160,160); title/row/key resolve ad hoc paint patches instead of Family::MENU recipes and consumer part patches. RULE slot is skipped entirely by keep_underlay branch. Exact public default_honors_border_patch passes with Magenta; underlay_honors_border_patch fails, actual RGB(58,58,58).
findings.repair: Resolve all colors/glyphs/state combinations through shared MENU variant/parts and honor part patches and slots in both modes. Keep generic fill/separator policy separate from theme resolution; remove fixed RGB literals from this behavioral option.

findings.title: Measured shortcuts and submenu affordances disappear in underlay drawing
findings.evidence: natural_width still resolves effective chords and reserves submenu space, but draw_underlay_row uses only item.hint, never effective_chord/ChordText, and does not render submenu marker. Exact public default_keeps_chord passes for configured x; underlay_keeps_chord fails. The submenu omission is source evidence, not a separate mouse submenu test.
findings.repair: Reuse the existing effective chord/case/keymap fallback and submenu marker/slot path. Underlay retention must not change item content or measurement/drawing agreement.

findings.title: Background-only layer fill drops underline color
findings.evidence: fill_keep_ink copies foreground and modifiers into an initially empty layer cell but omits underline_color. Real public Runtime layer probe starts page Red foreground, Green underline_color and UNDERLINED modifier. Outside page stays Green; filled layer cell retains Red and UNDERLINED but underline_color becomes Reset. Exact external underlay_keeps_underline_ink fails. self.mark(pos,None) also clears semantic role metadata; no independent dimming regression is claimed for that source observation.
findings.repair: Preserve all unaffected cell style channels and appropriate semantic role metadata when copying underlay ink, then override only requested background/symbol. Add real layer underline/color/attribute and role-aware dimming tests.
